data.exact_reserve_text: There has been a reassessment of the net provision for claims outstanding held at the previous year end. The release in 2016 amounted to $85.8m (2015: $146.4m), attributable to the following classes of business:
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 was $1,302.6m. The gross claims development triangle analysis indicates an aggregate adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately $31.8m across underwriting years up to 2014, driven by adverse development in certain years (notably 2012 and 2014) and large loss emergence. The managing agent reports a net release of $85.8m (net of reinsurance), attributable to positive movements across a number of classes (Marine, Political Lines, Property, Specialty and Treaty), reflecting significant reinsurance effects and class-level favourable development alongside large loss activity.
raw_causal_phrases: There has been a reassessment of the net provision for claims outstanding held at the previous year end.
The release in 2016 amounted to $85.8m (2015: $146.4m), attributable to the following classes of business:
The higher claims ratio was primarily driven by an increase in large losses in excess of $5m net which amounted to $78.7m (10.2%) compared with $48.5m (5.8%) in 2015.
This reflected the higher number of large losses - eight in comparison to five in 2015.
The Marine lines of business accounted for $37.5m of these losses.
A release was made from the prior year net provision for claims of $85.8m (2015: $146.7m) driven by positive movements across a number of classes.
data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly states a net prior-year release of $85.8m (net of reinsurance) by class, but the only reliable GROSS prior-year movement was derived from the gross claims development triangle (computed aggregate = +$31.8m strengthening). The note titled 'Movement in prior year's provision' presents net figures; per instructions those net figures were not used for the gross prior year movement. Class-level movement figures in the report are net amounts. Mapping of 'Political Lines' to a standard LOB ('Casualty') and 'Specialty' to 'Reinsurance - Specialty' is approximate for the lob_movements entries.
